text:
jordan: Customer hitting 413 on /v1/rerank, message just says 'payload too large'. They sent a long query plus ~200 docs, needs triage.
anya: Can you paste the raw request and error? 413 could be docs count or token limit or total body size.
jordan: Request id 01A9Z8-xyz, tenant redwood-corp. Here is redacted payload snippet:
```
{
  "query": "<~4k chars user search text>",
  "documents": ["<doc1 huge>", "<doc2 huge>", /* ... ~200 items ... */]
}
```
response: 413 Payload Too Large, body: {"error":"payload too large"}
sam: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) are they using the rerank endpoint (not embeddings) with the query included in body? 2) confirm if docs are raw full-text or already chunked/embeddings.
jordan: They pass raw article text. Prefer to send full docs, they expected API to accept it. Customer says docs are small but aggregated size hits limit.
eng-oncall: Likely we enforce max request body and also a per-item token cap + max docs count. Error message could be clearer. For now recommend chunking + send doc summaries.
anya: Repro steps for us: 1) use their tenant + request id 01A9Z8-xyz 2) replay with a subset to find threshold 3) capture server logs for quota and 'request_size' or 'total_tokens'
support-bot: Automated hint: our docs/limits page: max_docs=150, max_tokens_per_doc=4096, max_total_body_bytes=1_048_576 ; but UX currently returns generic 413.
sam: If bot limits are accurate, behavior: exceeding docs triggers 413 with generic text. Suggest engineering change: return structured error with fields {
  "code":"request_too_large",
  "reason":"docs_count_exceeded",
  "limits": {"max_docs":"150","max_total_tokens":"50000"},
  "advice":"chunk or summarize docs; send smaller batches"
}
jordan: Customer wants clear guidance and automated retry suggestions. They asked for a short-term workaround we can provide them.
eng-oncall: Short-term: 1) recommend client-side chunking script. 2) show them cURL example to split docs into batches of 50 and call rerank sequentially, then merge scores. Example:
```
for batch in batches(docs, 50):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"query":"...","documents":batch}'
```
We should include sample code in KB.
anya: I'll draft a KB note with script and include a warning about results being slightly different if context windows change. Also ask product to add clearer 413 payload.
sam: Can we ask infra for logs and exact rejection reason? eng-oncall, can you pull server-side rejection reason for 01A9Z8-xyz and paste the line (e.g., "rejection=docs_count:201")?
eng-oncall: Got it, pulling now. Log line: "reject_request tenant=redwood-corp id=01A9Z8-xyz reason=docs_count_exceeded value=200 limit=150"
jordan: Perfect — escalate: docs_count_exceeded. Customer notified and accepted batching workaround. They asked for UX change timeline.
anya: I'll open a JIRA for improving 413 message and add a simple SDK helper to auto-batch. Tagging product and docs.
support-bot: Ticket created: INF-4321 (improve rerank error details + SDK helper). ETA requested.
sam: Thanks team. I'll follow up with customer template and code snippet. :thumbsup:
